$comment: Illustration slot tracker (DESIGN-002 §Illustration slots). Each slot is {status, file, alt}: status 'real' = house-style SVG in src/assets/svg (SlotArt renders it as an with the alt text below), 'lab-owned' = the renderer draws its own scene inline. Hotspot bases (scene-atv-anatomy, scene-trail-hazards) are authored on a 500x300 (5:3) canvas and composed so the curriculum's hotspot x/y percentages land on the named features — present them at their intrinsic 5:3 ratio (SlotArt ratio="5 / 3") so percent coordinates stay exact.

hero-landing.alt: Illustration: A rider in full gear — helmet, gloves, boots — sits upright on a four-wheeled ATV on a blazed mountain trail, magenta waypoint diamonds receding along the route, fireweed blooming at the trail edge.
hero-landing.note: GPT Image (gpt-pack batch 01, a001-hero-landing.png), reviewed against the Part 5 rubric 2026-08-16; supersample-downscaled AVIF/WebP/PNG ladder.

hero-m1-mindset.alt: Illustration: A rider stands beside a parked, switched-off ATV at a trail junction, a dotted scan line tracing from their visor to the blazed left route while an unmarked route fades right — the line is chosen before it is ridden.
hero-m1-mindset.note: GPT Image (gpt-pack batch 01, a002-hero-m1-mindset.png), reviewed against the Part 5 rubric 2026-08-16; supersample-downscaled AVIF/WebP/PNG ladder.

scene-atv-anatomy.alt: Illustration: A utility ATV in side view against a plain ground, drawn flat and unshaded so its parts read clearly — front and rear racks, handlebars, seat, engine and driveline, footwell, and both knobbly tires. Four thin leader lines run out from the machine to the labelled waypoints.
scene-atv-anatomy.note: GPT Image (gpt-pack batch 01, a003-hero-m2-machine.png), promoted from hero art to the m2-l1-s2 anatomy scene 2026-08-18; cropped (0,22,1536,943) to hold the 5:3 coordinate contract. Four drawn leader lines fix the positions of waypoints 1 (tires), 2 (handlebars), 7 (racks) and 8 (chassis) — those markers sit at the free end of each line, so the crop must not change without re-measuring them. Supersample-downscaled AVIF q72 / WebP q92 / PNG ladder.

scene-walkaround-top.note: The walkaround lab renderer authors its own interactive top-view scene inline; SlotArt keeps the designed placeholder for this slot.

scene-helmet-fit.alt: A full-face helmet worn and fastened, cut away to show three layers — hard outer shell, thick crushable liner, thin comfort padding — with gloved fingers slid under the chin strap to check its tightness.
scene-helmet-fit.note: GPT Image batch 14 (artgen/incoming/batch-14/a011-scene-helmet-fit.png), 2026-08-23. Re-roll of the batch-13 plate under artgen/gpt-pack/batches/batch-14-plate-rerolls.md, whose binding rule is the REAR-VIEW RULE: a quad drawn from directly behind shows two tires, the front pair hidden. The batch-13 plate for keylist-pavement-physics was rejected for splaying all four wheels into view. Integrated as scaled to 95% and padded on the plate ground to fit 5:3 without clipping the gloved hand. Owner accepted all seven on 2026-08-23 with known residuals recorded in the session review.

scene-trail-hazards.alt: A mid-morning forest trail dipping through a drainage, broadcasting seven cues: a blind crest, an off-camber section, shadowed ruts, a dark wet patch at the low point, gravel over hardpack on the climb out, a downed limb screened by brush, and a soft undercut edge above the water.
scene-trail-hazards.note: GPT Image via Codex $imagegen (artgen/incoming/batch-13/a009-scene-trail-hazards.png), 2026-08-21, reviewed at full size against VISUAL_ASSETS Part 5 and the batch-13 checklist (artgen/VISUAL_AUDIT_M3-M6.md). Replaces the authored SVG hunt base. Cropped to 5:3 from the TOP (0,0,1536,922) so the blind crest survives. COORDINATE CONTRACT: six of the seven m4-l1-s2 hotspot x/y values were re-measured to this plate's features (shadow_rut unchanged) and recorded in BUILDLOG — do not change this crop without re-measuring. No magenta and no markers in the art: the renderer draws them. Retired SVG kept at svg/scene-trail-hazards.svg.

scene-crossing.alt: Seen from above, a quad stopped square behind the stop bar where a dirt trail meets a paved road, dotted sight lines running both ways along the road, a straight crossing lane at a right angle to the far side, a second machine waiting behind the first, and a car some distance away.
scene-crossing.note: GPT Image batch 14 (artgen/incoming/batch-14/a012-scene-crossing.png), 2026-08-23. Re-roll of the batch-13 plate under artgen/gpt-pack/batches/batch-14-plate-rerolls.md, whose binding rule is the REAR-VIEW RULE: a quad drawn from directly behind shows two tires, the front pair hidden. The batch-13 plate for keylist-pavement-physics was rejected for splaying all four wheels into view. Integrated as centre-crop 3:2, presented whole. Owner accepted all seven on 2026-08-23 with known residuals recorded in the session review.

scene-loading-cargo.alt: Rear-view comparison of rack loading: a low, centered, strapped case with a low center of gravity beside a tall loose stack whose high center of gravity tips the machine; the tall stack is marked as the wrong choice.
scene-loading-cargo.note: GPT Image batch 14 (artgen/incoming/batch-14/a013-scene-loading-cargo.png), 2026-08-23. Re-roll of the batch-13 plate under artgen/gpt-pack/batches/batch-14-plate-rerolls.md, whose binding rule is the REAR-VIEW RULE: a quad drawn from directly behind shows two tires, the front pair hidden. keylist-tcloc.alt: Plan view of a quad ATV with five inspection stops arranged around it as a dashed walking loop, arrows running one way: a knobby tire, a handlebar, a headlight, an oil droplet and a welded frame joint.
keylist-tcloc.note: GPT Image (c160-keylist-tcloc.png), 2026-08-19. Replaced the authored SVG, whose two weakest icons did not read (a crosshair meant to be a tire, a parallelogram meant to be a frame) and whose walk order was conveyed by making the learner count one to five dots under each badge. Presented at 3:2 — its native ratio — by the hotspot_figure block, NOT the 5:3 of a plain figure: the five stops are click targets at fixed percentages, so any crop would move them. The retired SVG is kept at svg/keylist-tcloc.svg.

keylist-three-leaks.alt: A gauge labelled "judgment level" beside a tank: a dashed line marks where full was, and the level sits well below it, draining through three separate leaks of equal size into three pools underneath. Thoughts surface in the tank as it empties — "Everyone else went.", "Don't hold them up.", "I know this trail.", "Nothing new here.", "We've come this far.", "But I'm almost there." — and once it is low, the leaks stop and fresh judgment pours back in from above.

keylist-fit-checks.alt: A seated rider measured against four independent pass-or-fail gates - reach, stance, leverage and machine class - each drawn as a dimension that either fits between the gate posts or does not.

keylist-helmet-consequences.alt: A helmet cross-section with the crushable liner highlighted as the mechanism, and four causal arrows out to the rules that follow from it: worn and fastened, fitted, rated, and crushable only once.
keylist-helmet-consequences.note: m3-l1-s1 already carries scene-helmet-fit (C-013, wave V1); VISUAL_ASSETS.md 7.3.0 permits one figure per step

keylist-stability-model.alt: A rear view of a rider on a quad with the centre of gravity marked in the rider's torso and a plumb line falling inside the track width between the tires; four medallions around it show the same machine on an uphill slope, on a side-slope, with the rider leaning uphill, and carrying a tall rear load.
keylist-stability-model.note: GPT Image batch 14 (artgen/incoming/batch-14/c006-keylist-stability-model.png), 2026-08-23. Re-roll of the batch-13 plate under artgen/gpt-pack/batches/batch-14-plate-rerolls.md, whose binding rule is the REAR-VIEW RULE: a quad drawn from directly behind shows two tires, the front pair hidden. Owner accepted all seven on 2026-08-23 with known residuals recorded in the session review.

keylist-four-families.alt: A plate split in two: on the left, rain and low light falling on a dirt trail; on the right, a geared rider between a thermometer reading cold and hot and a machine ahead trailing dust — the two families that change the trail, and the two that change the rider.
keylist-four-families.note: GPT Image batch 14 (artgen/incoming/batch-14/c007-keylist-four-families.png), 2026-08-23. keylist-before-you-go.note: GPT Image via Codex $imagegen (artgen/incoming/batch-13/c008-keylist-before-you-go.png), 2026-08-21, reviewed at full size against VISUAL_ASSETS Part 5 and the batch-13 checklist (artgen/VISUAL_AUDIT_M3-M6.md). keylist-three-standards.alt: At a forest trail junction a single post carries three square signs: a bottle and glass struck through, a hiker and a horse given room by a machine pulled aside, and a trail with its shortcut crossed out — a geared rider stopped beneath them.

match-thumb-throttle.alt: Thumb throttle: the rider's right hand gripping the bar, thumb pressing down the flat throttle paddle hinged below it.

match-front-brake.alt: Front brake: the hand lever on its perch — a long blade tapering from the pivot to a ball at the tip, swept out ahead of the grip.

match-rear-brake.alt: Rear/foot brake: an over-the-ankle riding boot with its toe down on the cleated pedal pad.

match-stop-switch.alt: Engine stop switch: a two-way rocker in a raised housing, thrown to the red off side that carries the power mark, so it can be found by feel.

match-gear-selector.alt: Gear selector: a ball lever standing in the deep leg of a doglegged gate plate.

match-body-position.alt: Body position, the invisible control: a helmeted rider up off the seat with weight carried forward over the bars, the direction of the shift marked in clay.

match-turnaround-time.alt: Turnaround time: a clock face above a U-turn arrow — the hour you head back, fixed before you leave.

match-off-ride-contact.alt: Off-ride contact: someone at home at a lit window with a phone, waiting on the check-in — a person who is not on the ride.

match-water-food.alt: Water and food beyond the plan: a part-full bottle beside a ration bar pushed up out of its wrapper.

match-nav.alt: Signal-free navigation: a folded paper map with a compass laid across its corner — neither needs a phone or a signal.

match-warmth.alt: Warmth for an unplanned wait: a quilted insulating layer folded down into a stack, collar showing.

section-briefing.alt: Briefing section: a trailhead post with its board pointing the way out.

section-learn.alt: Learn section: the field guide open on its spine.

section-try.alt: Try section: a boot sole pressed into the trail.

section-debrief.alt: Debrief section: a backward glance, the arc turning to look down the trail already ridden.

section-journal.alt: Journal section: a pen set to the ruled line.

section-checkpoint.alt: Checkpoint section: the trail blaze on its post, the mark you ride to.

sort-gear-helmet.alt: A rated full-face helmet with the chin strap fastened through its buckle.

sort-gear-eyes.alt: Riding goggles on a head strap — eye protection for every ride.

sort-gear-boots.alt: A riding boot whose shaft stands well above the ankle line.

sort-gear-gloves.alt: A riding glove with a fastened cuff — hands covered on every ride.

sort-gear-longs.alt: A long-sleeved jersey and full-length trousers — arms and legs covered.

sort-gear-chest.alt: A chest and roost protector — body armour added when conditions call for it.

sort-gear-hiviz.alt: A high-visibility whip flag on its mast — being seen when conditions hide you.

sort-gear-layers.alt: Weather layers stacked with the outer shell on top of the insulation.

sort-gear-loose.alt: A loose scarf trailing into a turning wheel — never worn on the machine.

sort-gear-flipflops.alt: A flip-flop sandal — footwear that never goes on the machine.

sort-gear-headphones.alt: Headphones sealing both ears — hearing shut off, never on the machine.

sort-cond-dust.alt: A machine riding into a dust cone with the trail ahead lost from view.

sort-cond-wet-roots.alt: A band of wet roots crossing the trail — slow down and add space.

sort-cond-frost.alt: Frost still lying in shade after sun-up — slow down and add space.

sort-cond-fading-light.alt: A clock against a sun already setting on the horizon — change the route or the schedule.

sort-cond-storm.alt: A weather front line with rain falling behind it — change the route or the schedule.

sort-cond-swollen-creek.alt: A creek running high and fast between its banks, well over its normal level — change the route.

sort-cond-cold-hands.alt: A hand gone cold and stiff on the brake lever — stop and tend the rider.

sort-cond-heat.alt: Hard sun and a water bottle already empty — stop and tend the rider.

sort-cargo-kid-behind.alt: A second person carried behind the operator on a single-seat machine — never done.

sort-cargo-two-up.alt: A purpose-built two-seat machine carrying two geared riders in their own seats.

sort-cargo-rack-limits.alt: A low load strapped down on the rack, inside its posted weight limit.

sort-cargo-heavy-high.alt: A tall load riding high on the rack, lifting the machine's centre of gravity — check it first.

sort-cargo-towing.alt: A machine towing a small trailer — check the hitch and the load before you go.

sort-cargo-lap.alt: A small child riding on the operator's lap, over the controls — never done.

sort-cargo-loose-tools.alt: Unsecured tools bouncing loose in the front basket — secure them before you go.

walk-tires-ok.alt: One rear knobby tire seen square from the side, sitting on flat ground with a full, evenly rounded sidewall and a short narrow contact patch — the profile of a tire at pressure.
walk-tires-ok.note: GPT Image (walkaround change-detector pack, c150), 2026-08-18. HELD, not wired: the m2-l3-s2 change detector needs a matched PAIR per zone and this plate has no usable partner — its 'after' came back as the same wheel drawn smaller and floating off the ground line rather than a squatting one (staged as _spare-tire-rejected.png; translation-testing confirmed it, aligning improved the match 6% against 41% for the genuinely misregistered lights pair). The ladder is already exported. Land a real low-pressure plate as walk-tires-low, flip this back to real, and add the T entry to walkaroundZones.ts — the lab picks it up with no other change.

walk-controls-ok.alt: The right handlebar from the rider's seat: the ribbed grip whole and closed at its outboard end, the brake lever on its perch at a normal standoff.
walk-controls-ok.note: GPT Image (walkaround change-detector pack, c151), reviewed 2026-08-18; supersample-downscaled AVIF/WebP/PNG ladder. Paired plate for the m2-l3-s2 change detector — the reference state for the controls zone.

walk-controls-torn.alt: The same handlebar, but the outboard end of the grip has split open and pulled back off the bar, leaving the bar end bare where a hand would sit.
walk-controls-torn.note: GPT Image (walkaround change-detector pack, c152), reviewed 2026-08-18; supersample-downscaled AVIF/WebP/PNG ladder. Paired plate for the m2-l3-s2 change detector — the changed state for the controls zone: a torn grip.

walk-lights-ok.alt: The front of the machine straight on: the headlight pod set into the bodywork with its lens clean and whole, the light off.

walk-lights-cracked.alt: The same headlight, but the lens now carries a star of fracture lines radiating from a single impact point — the housing intact, nothing missing.

level-1-trailhead.alt: Level 1, Trailhead: a single trailhead post carrying one blaze on otherwise empty ground - the route has not started yet.

level-2-greenhorn.alt: Level 2, Greenhorn: the trailhead post with the first blazed trail segment leaving it toward a marker not yet reached.

level-3-pathfinder.alt: Level 3, Pathfinder: a blazed post standing at a fork, one branch chosen and blazed while the other fades away unmarked - the route is now a decision.

level-4-trailhand.alt: Level 4, Trailhand: a worked trail carrying three blazes across two contour terraces - the ground itself has become legible, not just the path.

level-5-ridge-runner.alt: Level 5, Ridge Runner: a ridge profile stacked in front of a back range, with the blazed trail running the whole spine from the low ground to the peak.

level-6-wayfinder.alt: Level 6, Wayfinder: a graduated eight-point compass card set on a nested contour field - this rider reads both the ground and the bearing.

level-7-trail-boss.alt: Level 7, Trail Boss: three ranges deep with a foreground bench, the blazed climb reaching a summit marker at the top - the fullest emblem in the ladder.

artifact-risk-profile.alt: Risk profile artifact: a ruled notebook page holding four honest entries about your own riding, the second marked with a trail blaze as the leak most likely to catch you.

artifact-inspection-log.alt: Inspection log artifact: five T-CLOC zone rows walked top to bottom in fixed order, four zones ticked and the fifth still open with the marker sitting against it.

artifact-gear-card.alt: Gear card artifact: a pocket card laid on the ruled page carrying the five every-ride items head to toe - full-face helmet, eye protection, long sleeves, gloves, over-ankle boots - with the helmet blazed as the non-negotiable.

artifact-hazard-brief.alt: Hazard brief artifact: three hazards written up on the ruled page, each filed under the cue that gives it away - a crest, shadowed ruts, a wet band - with the rut cue blazed as the one that decides the line.

artifact-readiness-plan.alt: Readiness plan artifact: the three things that make a ride recoverable - who you told, the return time you committed to, and the kit list leaving with you - with the clock hand blazed on the time.

artifact-ride-plan.alt: Ride plan artifact: the capstone. A full folded plan sheet, larger and more complete than any other artifact page, with six worked sections above the fold, a ruled summary strip below, and the trail blaze sealing it.

xp-step-complete.alt: One trail blaze: a step completed.

xp-lesson-complete.alt: A trail blaze inside a closed ring: a whole lesson finished.

xp-checkpoint-first-try.alt: A checkpoint pennant marked clean: the checkpoint passed on the first try.

xp-module-complete.alt: The badge frame, a blaze diamond earned: a module completed.

xp-journal-artifact.alt: A written notebook page: a journal artifact completed.

xp-scenario-best-path.alt: A fork with the better line taken and blazed: the best path found in a scenario.

xp-lab-objectives.alt: Three objectives ticked off: every lab objective met.

xp-capstone.alt: The ride-plan sheet folded into three panels: the capstone completed.

xp-final-assessment.alt: A summit marker standing over the range: the final assessment passed.

xp-tutor-first.alt: Ranger's campaign hat: the first question asked of the tutor.

empty-progress.alt: A trail odometer standing at zero, every counter drum still blank, with a blazed trail rising away beside it - no miles recorded yet, and the first one waiting.

empty-instructor.alt: A trailhead register box open on its post, the ruled columns of the ledger still blank and the pencil hanging unused - no learner has signed in yet.

state-403.alt: A staff-only service spur closed by a striped warden barrier beside the warden's post, while the learner's own blazed trail carries on open to the left - this route belongs to someone else, not to you later.

scene-six-decisions.alt: Illustration: one fully geared rider stands at the centre of a ring, with six equal medallions spaced evenly around it — a full-face helmet, a paved road, two riders on a machine built for one, a bottle beside a glass, a small rider next to an oversized machine, and a trail vanishing over a crest. Six decisions at equal distance from the rider; none outranks the others.
scene-six-decisions.note: GPT Image re-roll 2026-08-17 (artgen/incoming/batch-12/c001-scene-six-decisions.png), replacing the hand-drawn keylist-six-decisions SVG. Base plate for the m1-l1-s3 hotspot hunt, so it deliberately carries NO markers and NO fireweed magenta — the renderer draws the interactive markers and magenta means 'clickable'. Exported scale-to-FIT with paper side padding, not centre-cropped: the top and bottom medallions run past a 5:3 centre crop.

scene-six-decisions-cut.alt: Decorative overlay: the same six-decisions plate with its background removed, layered over the original so the interactive markers sit behind the artwork. It renders aria-hidden; scene-six-decisions carries the real description.
scene-six-decisions-cut.note: Alpha cut-out companion to scene-six-decisions: identical artwork with the page background flood-filled to transparent (contiguous fill from the border plus seeds inside the sage ring, near-white only, so every medallion interior and the rider's white gear survive). Layered ON TOP of the full plate with the interactive pink drawn between the two, so a marker can never paint over the artwork. Decorative duplicate - alt is intentionally empty; scene-six-decisions carries the description.
